title: Classroom and Driving in a group down a highway
content: In this dream, i was both in a classroom and in a van being transported. Now, the classroom was in my former church which has a school attached to it. I was in a classroom with my peers, but we were maybe all 12-15 (I’m 30 irl). But we were in the preschool wing of the school. The classrooms were large and rather empty, with just long 6 foot tables and chairs. Then at 11 am (this was repeated several times in the dream) the whole class filed out the door and into vans. We traveled down a highway. The highway seemed to be in the middle of a rural area (no buildings or structures on the side of the road, just trees and grass) but there was a lot of cars in the road as well.
